title: United States Senate expenditures, page B-1191

tables.label: Expenditure detail

structure.description: Document number, date posted, payee name, service start/end dates, description and amount. Start/end share a parent heading. Header and body have separate outer boxes; the body lacks internal column borders and per-record row rules. A dotted horizontal separator divides compensation entries from travel entries.

tables.notes: First body entries leave document and date fields blank. Travel descriptions wrap onto additional lines. Exact record count is not assigned from wrapped text lines.

review_method: Poppler full-page render, 1600-pixel maximum dimension, visually inspected
